PdfParser (smalot/pdfparser)
============================

Bundled in Prohibited Terms Scanner to read text from PDF files.

Original work:  PdfParser by Sébastien MALOT and contributors
Version:        2.12.5
Source:         https://github.com/smalot/pdfparser
License:        GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0 (LICENSE.txt). The LGPL v3
                adds permissions to the GNU General Public License v3.0, included
                as GPL-3.0.txt.

Modifications
-------------

This copy has been modified by PluginRx for Prohibited Terms Scanner. The
modifications only rename and relocate code so it cannot conflict with another
plugin that bundles a different version of the same library. Parsing behavior is
unchanged.

1. Every namespace is prefixed with "PTScannerVendor" using php-scoper 0.17.5
   (Smalot\PdfParser becomes PTScannerVendor\Smalot\PdfParser), using the
   configuration at the end of this file.
2. Two class names built from strings at runtime were updated to the prefixed
   namespace, so they resolve after scoping:
   - Encoding.php: the base encoding class name in getEncodingClass().
   - PDFObject.php: the font class name built from the font subtype.
3. Files were moved from src/Smalot/PdfParser/ to vendor/pdfparser/, and
   Composer's autoloader was replaced with vendor/pdfparser-autoload.php.
4. Only the library's source files are included. Tests, documentation and the
   symfony/polyfill-mbstring dependency are not bundled; PDF parsing uses the
   PHP mbstring extension.

Copyright and license headers in the source files are kept as they were.

To rebuild from the unmodified source, run "composer install" with the
composer.json and composer.lock in the plugin root, save the configuration below
as scoper.inc.php, then run php-scoper with it.

php-scoper configuration (scoper.inc.php):

<?php

return [
    'prefix' => 'PTScannerVendor',
    'finders' => [
        \Isolated\Symfony\Component\Finder\Finder::create()
            ->files()
            ->in( 'vendor/smalot' )
            ->name( '*.php' ),
    ],
    'patchers' => [
        static function ( string $file_path, string $prefix, string $contents ) : string {
            return str_replace( "'\\\\Smalot\\\\PdfParser\\\\", "'\\\\" . $prefix . "\\\\Smalot\\\\PdfParser\\\\", $contents );
        },
    ],
    'exclude-namespaces' => [],
    'expose-global-functions' => false,
    'expose-global-classes' => false,
];
